paragraphs.text: Glimmer is a creature type representing the light manifestations of the hopes and persistence of Duskmourn 's survivors , depicted in golden colors to produce a "sparkling effect."
Glimmers are primarily white -aligned, but appear in all colors .

Glimmers were introduced for Duskmourn: House of Horror . Alchemy: Duskmourn included 8 glimmers referencing 8 of the Bloomburrow animal architypes ( Frog and Rabbit weren't included). All the glimmers in Duskmourn: House of Horror and its supplemental sets were enchantment creatures .

They may be inspired by the Patronus Charm of the Harry Potter series. Both are manifestations of light, often taking animal form, that drive dark creatures away. Glimmers are manifestations of a person's hope, while the Patronus Charm is a manifestation of a person's happiest memories.
Duskmourn: House of Horror had a cycle of glimmer creatures.

As the physical manifestation of psychic phenomena, glimmers take the form of treasured childhood objects, fondly remembered pets, friends, or other comforts that a survivor holds to prevent giving up. Glimmers offer magical protection against Valgavoth ’s insidious malice and help keep survivors from succumbing to the House's influence, even after the two are separated.
They can be extinguished when their companion loses hope or dies, and most long-term survivors of the house no longer have their glimmers.
